title: Distributed Cache Stampede Mitigation & Stale-While-Revalidate
description: Draft challenge covering request coalescing (singleflight), probabilistic early expiration, and CDN cache keys.
author: Qodlume Editorial

questions.prompt: What technique prevents thousands of concurrent requests for an expired hot cache key from simultaneously querying the primary PostgreSQL database?

options.text: Request coalescing (singleflight / mutex lock per key) combined with stale-while-revalidate
Disabling connection pooling on the database
Setting Cache-Control: no-store on all responses
Increasing HTTP request timeout to 120 seconds

questions.explanation: Request coalescing ensures only one worker recomputes the expired cache entry while concurrent callers either wait for the in-flight promise or immediately receive slightly stale data via stale-while-revalidate.

references.title: RFC 5861: HTTP Cache-Control Extensions for Stale Content
